Senses.Explanation: A hand-off hinge: the speaker concedes the whole first half of the turn and immediately spends the concession — the line for leaving the gate, the line past buddha and patriarch, or why the bamboo comb both names and betrays. The demand side: Tianyin Yuanxiu strikes the staff once and gathers everything onto the staff-head, then since it is so asks the line for going out the gate — a wooden man clapping the clapper-board in the woods, a stone girl blowing the reed-pipe beyond the ridge; Eryin Mi verses the wide heaven-and-earth, and since it is so rules that here and there are all the local scenery and one's own territory, asking the advance-and-retreat line; Faxi Yin at the open transmission — the seal not bagged and hidden but handed on face to face — asks the line of the five petals' fragrance, one tap: may the spring wind push together, every branch burst into splendor; Liaozong Chaojian rules the way of buddha and patriarch everyone's share with nothing lacking, and since it is so asks the line past buddha and patriarch — the ten thousand forms dance together and the empty sky secretly nods. The cross-examination side: Dabo Qian concedes that his Tianjin is otherwise — mountains are mountains, monks are monks, the eight strokes of the character for eternity distinct — and since it is so asks how to keep and nourish it, sending the assembly back to the hall; Dahui Zonggao, told the level person does not speak and level water does not flow, asks since it is so why one deliberately raises wind and waves; Huijue Yi concedes the person grown top-of-heaven standing, nose straight and brow across, then asks the after-all-what of not-mind, not-buddha, not-thing — the fur-seal's navel called sea-dog kidney; Tian'an Sheng runs the timely rain and the hand-clapping songs — if you want it thus you must be thus, since it is thus only then can it be thus; Chaozong Tongren concedes the great release of no-dwelling and asks why calling it a bamboo comb bumps and not calling it betrays; Baichi Xingyuan counts the monk's hardships and since it is so calls the assembly to the buddha hall to burn incense and perform the lotus teaching together.
